source: Native AWS CLI via scripts/aws/aws_cli.py; delivered CloudTrail S3 JSON

analysis.recovery_note: Three creation lifecycles reused the exact owned bucket/trail names. First stopped before logging because CloudTrail reordered selectors. Second cleaned after streaming S3 CLI rejected --cli-input-json. Third retrieved real events; all three cleanup checks verified. Prior raw runs retained recursively.
observed_rules: All six captured cases have eventVersion 1.11, eventSource monitoring.amazonaws.com, eventCategory Data, managementEvent false, eventType AwsApiCall.
All six have resources exactly [{type: AWS::CloudWatch::Metric}]; no metric ARN, accountId, namespace or metricName appears inside resources.
responseElements is present and null for all successes and failures. readOnly is false for PutMetricData, true for all three read operations and the rejected statistics query.

PutMetricData retains namespace and ordered metricData metricName/dimensions identity only. Supplied timestamp, value, values, counts, unit and storageResolution are omitted, including on failure. A datum with no submitted dimensions omits dimensions.
GetMetricStatistics retains namespace, metricName, dimensions, startTime, endTime, period, statistics and unit in lowerCamelCase, including on failure.
GetMetricData retains nested metricDataQueries, metricStat/metric identity, period/stat/unit, returnData true and false, expression/label, scanBy, maxDatapoints and labelOptions.timezone.

GetMetricStatistics and GetMetricData request startTime/endTime are ISO-8601 UTC seconds with Z; submitted .123 fractions are absent. eventTime also uses whole-second UTC Z, not the locale-formatted timestamp in the documentation example.
ListMetrics retains namespace, metricName, dimensions and recentlyActive; includeLinkedAccounts:false is added despite omission in input.

Both rejected requests return CLI InvalidParameterValue HTTP 400 but CloudTrail errorCode InvalidParameterValueException. errorMessage retains the service message verbatim. Successful records omit both error fields.
unresolved: No named operation/failure projection remains unresolved.
Only the after-propagation six-request batch was retained; initial-batch non-observation does not prove absence or guaranteed delivery timing.
No entity metrics, omitted-statistics query, pagination token, access-denied, cross-account or other validation-error projection was exercised.

documentation_revision.rule: All four named APIs are DATA events, AWS::CloudWatch::Metric; not Event history.

redaction: Credential ID values, caller principal/ARN/name and client IP redacted; keys retained. Owned names/account, event/request IDs, times, projections and response fields unchanged. No debug logs retained. Integration normalization: caller account becomes 000000000000; owned trail/bucket/namespace/Probe suffix becomes owned. Event/request IDs, numeric data, timestamp precision and field presence remain unchanged.
